messages.subject: Stratton Energy – agreed Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia, Daniel,

Thanks for the call. I've turned the commercial points into a short heads of terms (strictly subject to contract) so we have a clean reference before drafting the MSA. The key figures are: £450,000 in year 1 with a 5% annual uplift, an £85,000 implementation fee, professional services at £1,250/day, a 36-month initial term and a 1 July go-live target.

Only the confidentiality and exclusivity paragraphs are intended to bind. If those numbers look right I'll start the first draft of the agreement this week.

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
